## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Name the plan stage and link a decision when relevant.

## Verification

Record the tested revision, actual commands and results. Explain skipped or blocked checks. For documentation-only changes, record accuracy/link review and `git diff --check`. Record the `make ci` result (there is no hosted CI).

## Demonstration

Give concise review or reproduction steps (for example, which place to open in Roblox Studio and what to do there).

## Dependencies and limitations

List prerequisite PRs, base-branch exceptions, simplifications added to the register in `docs/plan.md`, remaining risks and follow-up work, or state none. Merging and publishing the game require separate authorization.
